source.shell: frontend/index.html (favicon only; the direction contract is no longer embedded in the document)

ink-deep.displayName: Ink Deep (the ink under the hand)

display.purpose: The house name in the letterhead. 1.32rem / 900 / -0.02em, uppercase, line-height 1.

figure.purpose: The closing total ("Te queda"): 1.72rem Chivo Mono, tabular. The largest number on the sheet, and the only one that turns red when the month closes negative.

subtotal.purpose: The income and expense figures on the subtotal band: 1.22rem Chivo Mono, tabular.

ledger-amount.purpose: A movement's amount in the ledger and the cap field: 0.94rem Chivo Mono, right-aligned behind its + / -.

heading.purpose: The .sect h2 of every band: 0.74rem / 900 / 0.16em, uppercase, on the baseline of its 1px rule.

body.purpose: Reading copy, notes, hints and notices: 16px Libre Franklin at 1.45, measure capped at 66-74ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, plate lettering and .tag: 0.66rem / 700 / 0.14em, uppercase.

mono-micro.purpose: The document number Nº YYYY-MM, the page folio, the pager state and the ledger's line numbers: 0.68-0.76rem Chivo Mono.

shadows.name: sheet-rest
shadows.purpose: The sheet lying on the grey desk: a 1px hairline at the top edge plus one offset, soft, negatively-spread ground shadow. The system's only large shadow besides a window's.

shadows.name: window-over
shadows.purpose: A window thrown over the sheet. Never applied to a band, a field or a row.

shadows.name: plate-float
shadows.purpose: The action plate once it leaves the flow and floats over the sheet on a phone (below 720px, .membrete .plate position: fixed). Its only drop shadow; in the flow the plate carries just its inset edge.

shadows.name: double-rule
shadows.purpose: Draws the second line of the invoice's double rule under the 3px ink border of .membrete, .sub-line.total and .wtitle. It is a rule, not depth.

shadows.name: plate-edge
shadows.purpose: The printed lower edge of the action plate at rest.

shadows.name: plate-press
shadows.purpose: The plate's edge once the stamp goes down (:active), together with translateY(1px).

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: A flat ink wash behind a window. No backdrop-filter, no blur: the scrim dims the desk, it never frosts it.

motion.name: ink-dry
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the month's figures re-print in place (opacity 0.35 -> 1). Replayed by remounting the value spans with App's repaintKey after a save or a month change (KpiSummary, .repaint).

motion.name: ink-set
motion.purpose: The row just written takes one highlight (background rgba(178, 58, 32, 0.14) -> transparent) as the ink sets (.book tbody tr.flash).

motion.name: plate-state
motion.purpose: Hover deepens the stamp fill; pressing moves the plate down 1px and flips its inset edge.

motion.name: skip-link-slide
motion.purpose: The skip link slides into the top-left corner on focus (.skip-link, top: -100px -> 14px).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce nothing moves and every state stays readable.

breakpoints.name: desk
breakpoints.purpose: The sheet lifts off the desk: 30px auto margins and 34px 40px 46px padding instead of running edge to edge.

breakpoints.name: columns
breakpoints.purpose: .cols (donut + bars), .two (window form rows) and .jar-meta (reassignment selects) become two columns.

breakpoints.name: phone-table
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the ledger's action column wraps (white-space: normal; max-width: 96px) instead of widening the row; the letterhead's action plate leaves the flow (position: fixed, 16px from the right and bottom edges, z-index: 30) with the body reserving 104px of foot; and the pagination's buttons stack into a column so they never sit under the floating plate.

breakpoints.name: pointer-coarse
breakpoints.purpose: Raises every control below the comfortable minimum to 44px: .linkb, .book .acts .linkb, .iconb (width included), .pbtn, .row .capfield and .monthjump input[type=month]. Declared last in index.css on purpose: at equal specificity these only win by order, and higher up they stay inert.

browserSurfaces.name: selection
browserSurfaces.purpose: Selected text is ink struck by the stamp.

browserSurfaces.name: caret
browserSurfaces.purpose: The caret is the pen in the document's ink.

browserSurfaces.name: scrollbars
browserSurfaces.value: scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--color-rule-strong) transparent; ::-webkit-scrollbar 10px, thumb 2px transparent border with background-clip: content-box
browserSurfaces.purpose: The scrollbars of the ledger (beside .table-scroll), the bars scroller and a window body belong to the palette.

browserSurfaces.name: focus-ring
browserSurfaces.purpose: One visible ring everywhere, in the stamp's red; the cap field and the bars scroller restate it.

browserSurfaces.name: print
browserSurfaces.value: @media print hides .monthnav, .pager, .skip-link, .plate, .action-stamp; the sheet loses its shadow, its border and its max-width
browserSurfaces.purpose: A real document also leaves by printer.

fonts.purpose: The document face: house name, section heads, labels, body copy.
The measuring face at reading weight (pager ranges, chart labels).
Every amount, rate, date, count and line number.

accessibility.liveRegion: frontend/src/components/LiveRegion.tsx - the app's only role="status" region; announcements replace each other. The visible Notice is deliberately not a live region.

contrast.method: Ratios computed from the @theme token values, compositing rgba over the sheet's paper ground. A browser walk of every text node (verify.cjs) was re-run for the reconciliation pass: 0 failures over 339 text nodes at 1440 and 390, counting ancestor opacity.

constraints: Touch targets 42-46px at rest (.plate/.field/.seg 46px, .pbtn/.iconb 42px, .skip-link 44px) with a 44px floor on a coarse pointer.
Every control has an associated label; the gasto/ingreso, USD/VES and import groups are role=radiogroup with an aria-label.
Form errors use aria-invalid + aria-describedby and focus moves to the first field with an error; no role=alert per field.
No window.confirm anywhere: every interruption is the one Window primitive with focus moved in, trapped, restored, Escape to close and body scroll locked.

superseded: docs/architecture.md still documents the retired teal system (single hue 188, paletteFor, dark mode). docs/** is frozen by the project's ownership contract, so it was not edited; DESIGN.md supersedes it for visual decisions.

.impeccable/NEW-WORLD-SPEC.md and .impeccable/build-packet.md describe the previous chalk-board world ("La pizarra de la tasa", board/chalk/wood tokens, the #paint-rough filter). index.css no longer carries any of those tokens or classes; the contract also no longer ships inside frontend/index.html.

narrative.overview:
The month is one white invoice, bound like a savings passbook, that the visitor keeps re-writing. The whole screen is one sheet of cool white paper lying on a grey desk: the letterhead at the top, the month's three figures ruled into a subtotal band, the numbered line items of the ledger, the margin column of jars and wallets, and the perforation that ends the page. Nothing in it is a card: bands are separated by rules, and the rules are the structure.

The sheet is written with the marks a person physically makes on a document. A rubber stamp carries anything negative, anything over its cap, and the one action plate; a ballpoint carries the original bolívar amount of a movement; a highlighter marks a cap that is running out — always as a stroke behind the ink, never as a colour of its own. Attention that has to be legible as text uses a darker amber instead. Income is not a colour at all: it is print ink at full strength with a leading `+`, the way a signed ledger reads.

Every figure on the sheet carries its provenance in the line beside it — its date, its line number, the wallet and the note that produced it — so the visitor sees the month already closed into a total and still knows where each part of it came from. The two things this world refuses are named in its own material: the dashboard of soft-shadowed KPI cards (there is one sheet, and nothing on it is elevated) and the bureaucratic form (the movement form is a window over the sheet that first shows a "prueba de tira" — an estimate of where the movement will land, labelled as an estimate, before anything is saved).
keyCharacteristics: One sheet on a grey desk, ruled into bands; zero cards, zero rounded corners.
Cool white paper, near-black print ink; the only saturated fill is the stamp-red action plate.
Three marks only: stamp red, ballpoint blue, highlighter yellow — plus amber for attention text.
Libre Franklin for the document, Chivo Mono for every measured column, tabular figures everywhere.
Depth is material: one shadow for the sheet on the desk, one for a window over the sheet, and one for the action plate once it leaves the flow on a phone.
Both faces self-hosted and served from this origin; no external font, CDN or network request.
Two authored motions: the ink-dry re-print of the month's figures, and one flash on the row just written.

rules.name: The Three-Marks Rule
rules.body: Only three marks carry colour: the rubber stamp (red), the ballpoint (blue) and the highlighter (yellow). Amber is the same "attention" ink made readable as text. A fourth hue does not exist — a new state finds its mark, or it stays ink.

rules.name: The Ink-Only-Income Rule
rules.body: Income is never a colour: `.amt.income` is print ink at full strength with a leading `+`, exactly like `.amt.expense`. The sign carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Highlighter-Behind-Ink Rule
rules.body: The highlighter is a background stroke, never a text colour. When attention must be legible as lettering it is amber (`.row.warn`, `.wbar.warn`) or it is ink.

rules.name: The Never-Grey Rule
rules.body: Secondary and tertiary text are ink at reduced alpha over paper (0.66 → 5.7:1, 0.6 → 4.7:1). No grey and no tinted neutral is ever used to lower the voice, because the sheet has to stay legible in daylight.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is declared on `body` and inherited by everything, and restated on `.mono`/`.num`. No column of figures may shift width.

rules.name: The Measured-Mono Rule
rules.body: Chivo Mono is for money, rates, dates, counts, line numbers and codes — things that are measured, matched or listed in a column. It is never used to make something look technical.

rules.name: The One-Line Section Rule
rules.body: A section opens with a `.sect`: one `0.74rem`/900/`0.16em` uppercase heading and its 1px ink rule sharing a baseline, with the optional `sect-note` in Ink Dim at the far end of the row. The heading carries its own weight; the rule supplies the division.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: A surface never lifts. It is either printed on the sheet (fields, bars, tags, stamps) or it is a window over it. A card with a soft shadow does not belong to this world.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface declares its depth once, as ground contact: the sheet has one shadow, the window has one shadow. Nothing else in the sheet casts anything — except the action plate, and only once it has left the flow to float over the sheet on a phone.

dos: Do keep one sheet and divide it with rules (`.sect`, `.rule`, 2px/3px closers, dashed row separators). Bands are separated by ink, never by a card.
Do measure every figure in Chivo Mono with tabular numerals (`.num`, `.mono`, `.pen`, `.cap`, `.ln`) and right-align money.
Do set income as full ink with a leading `+`; the sign carries the meaning.
Do use the highlighter as a background stroke behind ink (`.mark`) and switch to amber (`--color-warn`, 4.8:1) the moment attention has to be lettering.
Do keep the stamp-red `.plate` the loudest element of the flow it belongs to.

Do put every interruption, form and destructive confirmation in the one window primitive with focus moved in, trapped and restored, Escape working, body scroll locked, and the panel positioned against the viewport so opening it never scrolls the document.
Do let every figure show its provenance: date, line number, wallet and note stay in the row beside the amount.
Do label a client-side estimate as an estimate ("Estimado, todavía sin guardar") and never as the stored figure.

Do verify contrast as a number against the real ground (ink 0.66 → 5.7:1, ink 0.6 → 4.7:1, control 0.46 → 3.0:1, stamp on paper 6.1:1, paper on stamp fill 5.7:1), and size the controls for touch — fields and the plate 46px, page and icon buttons 42px, and a 44px floor on a coarse pointer — with one visible 2px focus ring.
Do keep both faces self-hosted and versioned in the document's own stylesheet: no CDN, no external font, no network request at runtime.
donts: Don't introduce a fourth hue or a coloured fill that is not the stamp plate. The only other full fill in the system is print ink (`.pbtn.primary`), which is not a colour.
Don't round a corner: the sheet has `border-radius: 0` everywhere. The punch holes of `.perf` are the only curve.
Don't let a surface cast a shadow other than the sheet's, a window's or the floating action plate's; a band's depth is its rule.
Don't use the highlighter yellow as a text colour, and don't colour an income.
Don't recompute a stored business figure in the client; the API owns the numbers.
Don't use `window.confirm`, a `role="alert"` per field, or a second live region.
Don't add an entrance animation per section: the only two motions in the system are the ink-dry re-print of the month's figures (240ms) and the single flash of the row just written.
